metadata.description: One durable model/effort-tiering rule (tier), plus an optional mod that enforces it and shows cost and savings (tier-mod).

plugins.name: tier
plugins.description: Install a model/effort-tiering working preference into the current project - quality-first, cost-efficient. /tier writes a machine-local CLAUDE.local.md by default (your repo stays clean); /tier repo writes the committed CLAUDE.md for web + mobile coverage.

plugins.name: tier-mod
plugins.description: Tier: the main session manages, helpers do the work. Every hand-off names a model and an effort (max/Fable only after an opus/xhigh failure of that task); web work, big reads and multi-file edits go to tier-mod:reader / tier-mod:editor; a ledger records what each hand-off cost, its check's exit code, and what it saved.
